description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Server which implements an XML-RPC server using the Zend Framework. It includes methods for attaching functions and classes, handling requests, loading functions, and managing system methods. It serves as a core component for setting up and running an XML-RPC server, with extensive external dependencies and system initializations.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Server
classes.description: Implements an XML-RPC server allowing for attaching functions and classes, handling requests, and managing system methods as part of the Zend Framework's XML-RPC capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the server and sets up system methods.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Proxy for calling system object methods.

methods.name: addFunction
methods.description: Attaches a callback as an XMLRPC method, with optional namespace prefix.

methods.name: setClass
methods.description: Attaches class methods as XMLRPC method handlers.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Creates a fault response with a specified message or exception.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an XML-RPC request and returns a response or fault.

methods.name: loadFunctions
methods.description: Loads functions as returned from a server definition, typically used with cached dispatch tables.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Sets the character encoding for the server and associated XMLRPC values.

methods.name: getEncoding
methods.description: Retrieves the current character encoding.

methods.name: setPersistence
methods.description: No-op: persistence is managed via cache.

methods.name: setRequest
methods.description: Sets the request object, validating type and class.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the currently registered request object.

methods.name: setResponseClass
methods.description: Sets the class used for the response output.

methods.name: getResponseClass
methods.description: Returns the current response class name.

methods.name: getDispatchTable
methods.description: Returns the dispatch table of method definitions.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns all registered functions/methods.

methods.name: getSystem
methods.description: Returns the system object managing XML-RPC system methods.

methods.name: sendArgumentsToAllMethods
methods.description: Sets or gets whether to send arguments to all methods.

methods.name: _fixType
methods.description: Maps PHP types to XML-RPC types.

methods.name: _handle
methods.description: Performs the actual work of calling a method according to the request.

methods.name: _registerSystemMethods
methods.description: Initializes and registers system.* methods for the server.
